landing.hero: Compare car listings in one place.
landing.subtitle: Bring new and used car listings from mobile.de, AutoScout24 and Otomoto into one collection. Compare prices, mileage and equipment side by side, then use AI-assisted analysis to prepare your questions for the seller.
landing.section1Desc: Found cars on mobile.de, AutoScout24 or Otomoto? Paste a listing link or a search URL into Garageview to import cars into your collection. Keep photos, available specifications, prices and seller details together, even when your shortlist spans different sites.
landing.section1Desc2: Group cars by model, budget, or whatever makes sense for your search. See price ranges, mileage spreads, and freshness at a glance. This is your car search command center.
landing.section2Title: Which car has what? Now you know.
landing.section2Desc: That moment when you can't remember which car had parking sensors and which had the panoramic roof? Gone. A full comparison table puts every car in a column and every feature in a row. Green check or red X — instantly clear.
landing.section2Desc2: Filter by any feature to find the best-equipped option in seconds. Heated seats? LED headlights? Adaptive cruise? One click and you know exactly which cars have it.
landing.section3Desc: That perfect car might be 2 hours away — or in another country. See every dealer on an interactive map with estimated drive and flight times from your location. Know before you call whether it's a Saturday trip or needs a plane ticket.
landing.section3Desc2: Every car card shows travel time at a glance. Plan a route that hits three dealers in one day, or decide that one car isn't worth a 6-hour drive. Smart decisions start with good information.
landing.section4Desc: Here's what takes hours to do manually: reading every listing carefully, cross-checking specs against descriptions, researching fair pricing, spotting red flags. Your AI expert does all of this in one click — and gives you a ranked verdict with clear reasoning for every car.
landing.section4Desc2: Then ask it anything. "Which car will cost me least to own?" "Is Car #2's warranty worth the extra price?" "What should I check during the test drive?" — real answers backed by every detail from every listing.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Free for car buyers across Europe. Sign in and import your first search in 30 seconds.
landing.metaDescription: Compare new and used cars from mobile.de, AutoScout24 and Otomoto. Save listings, compare prices and equipment, and get AI-assisted insights.
landing.importNote: Paste links from all three sites into the web app. The Chrome extension saves listings directly from mobile.de.
